title: LIAN Batch Task
description: Schema for a single task entry in a batch-launch task file.

wt.description: Worktree directory name under the worktree root.

branch.description: Git branch name for this task's worktree.

prompt.description: Task prompt text passed to Claude Code via stdin.

type.description: Task type. Controls boundary rules and PR expectations.

conflictGroup.description: Conflict group name. Tasks in the same group must not run in parallel unless the group is docs/review/planning.

targetIssue.description: Primary GitHub issue number this task targets.

targetPr.description: Existing PR number this task updates.

allowedFiles.description: File patterns the task may modify. Supports exact paths, dir/**, and glob-like *. Empty means unrestricted.

forbiddenFiles.description: File patterns the task must never modify. Overrides allowedFiles.

validation.description: Validation commands to run after task completion.

reviewer.description: Reviewer agent or user assigned to accept this task.

followUpPolicy.description: What happens after this task passes audit. serial-aggregator triggers a follow-up worker.
